info.title: Horus API
info.description: Programmatic access to everything in Horus. See https://horusship.com/docs/api.

bearer.description: An API key (`ak_…`, legacy `horus_pat_…`) or an OAuth access token.

held.description: Fulfilment is paused and needs attention.

id.description: Event id (also the `webhook-id` header). Dedupe on it: delivery is at-least-once.

created.description: When the event happened (ISO-8601). Deliveries are not ordered; use this.

source_sku.description: Source product id (ASIN, Walmart item id, ...).

account_id.description: Buyer account the listing is sourced through.

discord_linked_at.description: Horus access is granted through Discord; null = not linked yet.

daily_cap.description: Sourcing crawl jobs allowed per rolling 24 h.

removed.description: Rows removed per kind (sales, listings, accounts, ...).

session_valid.description: Whether the desktop last found the account signed in; null = not checked since the last credential change.

instance_id.description: Paired desktop this account runs on (pinned on first job).

inbox_id.description: Email inbox the desktop reads sign-in OTPs from.

has_auth.description: The proxy carries a username/password (never returned).

number.description: Full card number, or the last 4 for a store card.

allOf.description: Sum of recorded sale profit in the period, excluding REFUNDED and CANCELLED sales.

listings.description: LISTED tasks created in the period.

charts.description: Daily series; missing days are filled with 0 when a period is set.

allOf.description: Frozen estimates of PAID sales; null until one is paid.
Actual minus estimate on PAID sales; positive = better than estimated.

categories.description: Rolled up by the title's first word (Horus doesn't store eBay categories).

vero_protection_enabled.description: On a VeRO takedown, blacklist the brand and end its other listings.

vero_mode.description: GROUP = share takedowns with, and be protected by, the community pool.

seller_risk_alerts_enabled.description: Alert when an eBay account's seller standard drops.

active_size.description: Brands reported by enough sellers to block.

online.description: A paired desktop heartbeated in the last 90 s.

engine_status.description: Browser engine for retailer automation: ready | downloading | failed | unknown.

account_automation_ready.description: Walmart/Target/Best Buy/AliExpress jobs can run (engine ready).

held_sale_count.description: Sales waiting for the desktop to come back online.

engine_status.description: Browser engine for retailer automation: ready | downloading | failed | unknown.

last_known_ip.description: Public IP the desktop last checked in from; accounts pinned here always use it.

account_count.description: Buyer accounts pinned to this machine.

missing_scopes.description: OAuth scopes eBay refused; reconnect to restore those features.

url.description: Open in a browser signed in to the eBay seller account; eBay redirects back to Horus to finish.

sale_id.description: The sale created for this order; poll `GET /sales/{id}`.

queued.description: Checkout was handed to the desktop (or held until it reconnects).

held.description: Desktop offline or manual purchase needed — see the sale's `fulfillment.hold_reason`.

website.description: ACCOUNT groups: the website every account in it uses.

item_count.description: Accounts, proxies or listings in the group.

has_credentials.description: An app password (IMAP) or OAuth token is stored.

account_count.description: Buyer accounts linked to this inbox.

url.description: Open in a browser; the provider redirects back to Horus, which stores the inbox.

title.description: Null until the product has been scraped.

allOf.description: Source cost at the last scrape.

ad_rate_pct.description: Promoted Listings ad rate synced from eBay.

studio_template_id.description: Null = the user's default template; "" = no Studio render.

end_reason.description: Why it was ended: source_out_of_stock, source_product_not_found, source_unavailable, source_price_too_high, vero, user… Null while live.

skipped.description: Listings with an order in flight.

occurred_at.description: The most recent event in the cluster.

auto_skip_reason.description: Why the refund wasn't started automatically (over_threshold, past_window, ...).

task_id.description: The listing task this sale came from.

sku.description: Source product id (ASIN, Walmart item id, ...).

allOf.description: What the buyer paid for the line (all units).
Estimate until eBay pays out, then actual.
Frozen estimate from when the sale was created.

account_id.description: Buyer account that placed (or was linked to) the source order.

cancelled_at.description: When the source store cancelled the order after purchase.

desktop_status.description: QUEUED / IN_PROGRESS / HELD / SUCCEEDED / FAILED for desktop checkout; null otherwise.

releasable.description: HELD because the desktop was offline: `POST /sales/{id}/release` re-queues it.

bundle.description: Multi-item orders: one source checkout job per item.

source_orders.description: Scraped source-store orders matched to this sale (see `/source_orders`).

ebay_order_cancelled.description: False when there was no eBay order or eBay refused — cancel it in Seller Hub.

order_provider.description: NATIVE = your Horus Desktop places orders.

native_fallback.description: Fall back to the proxied path when the desktop can't place an order.

proxyless_checkouts.description: Desktop checkouts without a proxy (NATIVE only).

enabled.description: Auto-recover Amazon accounts hit by a forced password reset.

template.description: New-password template ({seq}, {rand:N}, {sym:N}, {year}, ...); null = random strong password.

vero_protection_enabled.description: On a VeRO takedown, blacklist the brand and end your other listings of it.

vero_mode.description: GROUP = share/benefit from the community VeRO brand pool.

url_hint.description: Masked URL; the token is never returned.

markup_percent.description: Markup over source cost for new listings.

default_stock.description: Quantity new listings are created with.

replenish.description: Restock the listing quantity after a sale.

refresh_enabled.description: End and relist listings that haven't sold.

refresh_hours.description: Hours without a sale before a refresh (min 24).

min_profit_roi_percent.description: Minimum ROI on source cost when buying above the listed cost.

still_purchase_if_profitable.description: Buy even when the source price rose, if the ROI floor still holds.

auto_cancel_hours.description: Cancel unfulfilled eBay orders after this many hours (default 72).

auto_cancel_terminal_failures.description: Auto-cancel orders that can never ship (restricted / digital) (default true).

cycle_buyer_account_on_failure.description: Move a sale to another buyer account when one is locked (default true).

mass_delist_on_account_failure.description: End the locked account's listings when no other account can take them (default true).

marketplace_fee_percent.description: eBay final value fee % used for profit math (default 13.25).

promoted_listings_ad_rate_percent.description: Ad spend % subtracted from the purchase ceiling (default 0).

markup_includes_ad.description: Apply markup to cost + ad fee (default false).

tracking_provider.description: Where tracking numbers come from (default aqualine).

max_sale_price.description: Only auto-approve sales at or under this price (default 50).

max_days_since_sale.description: Only auto-approve within this many days of the sale (default 30).

paid_label_opt_in.description: Accept a paid return label when no free method exists.

polling_enabled.description: Hourly sweep for returns eBay didn't notify.

order_provider.description: NATIVE = your Horus Desktop places orders.

native_fallback.description: Fall back to the proxied path when the desktop can't place an order.

proxyless_checkouts.description: Desktop checkouts without a proxy (NATIVE only).

vero_protection_enabled.description: On a VeRO takedown, blacklist the brand and end your other listings of it.

vero_mode.description: GROUP = share/benefit from the community VeRO brand pool.

discord_webhooks.description: Replaces all Discord webhooks (one per type); [] clears them.

detailed.description: A detail scrape has been seen (totals/items), not just the order-list summary.

sale.description: The sale this order fulfils; null = placed outside Horus (unmatched).

items.description: Line items as scraped (title, quantity, price, ...).

queued.description: False when the same search is already queued.

saturation.description: Other eBay sellers listing the same ASIN (null = not measured yet).

vero_risk.description: The ASIN drew a VeRO takedown in the last 90 days.

min_match_score.description: 0-1; weaker title matches are hidden from the feed.

auto_sourcing_enabled.description: Master switch for this user's desktop/extension sourcing loops.

brand_blocklist.description: Feed items whose eBay title contains one of these are hidden.

max_price.description: Upper bound of the source-price band (USD).

margin_pct.description: Markup % for products in this band.

item_count.description: Product image slots (1 = single listing, N = N-item bundle).

slot_mode.description: manual = slots placed in the layout; auto = grid-tiled at render time.

layout.description: Canvas JSON: { width, height, background, layers[] } (productImage / badge / asset / text layers).

samples.description: True when these are borrowed sample products, not the user's listings.

events.description: Event types, `<area>.*` or `*`. Empty = every event.

status.description: `auto_disabled`: switched off after 3 days of failed deliveries.

payload_format.description: `v2` = the documented envelope; `v1` = the legacy `{ id, event, data, createdAt }` body (endpoints created before webhooks v2).

secret_rotating_until.description: While set, deliveries are signed with the new and the previous secret.

secret.description: Signing secret (`whsec_…`). Shown on create and rotate; also readable via `GET /webhooks/{id}/secret`.

headers.description: As sent on the last attempt (signature recomputed for that attempt's timestamp).

next_attempt_at.description: When the next retry runs (pending only).

delete.summary: Permanently delete your Horus account and everything in it
delete.description: Irreversible. Send your account email as `confirm_email`. Live eBay listings are NOT ended on eBay; only Horus's records are removed.
